7294.title: Credential-store health detection
7294.rootCauseOneLine: The health check maps a missing credential file directly to unauthenticated without consulting the provider's own login state.
7294.proposedFix: Validate a noninteractive native account-status interface on macOS and use it for health detection instead of file absence.
7294.caveats: Two clean backend runs used a credential-free CLI fixture; native macOS Keychain and desktop behavior remain unverified. Reproduction test is inline per reports repository policy. No PR: partial native reproduction and authentication-change exclusion.
